note: Tippah County publishes no county-wide zoning: a county administration letter says no county zoning restrictions apply outside municipal limits. The only zoning published by a city is the City of Ripley's, as a scanned PDF map (City of Ripley Zoning Map Scan) plus the zoning ordinance PDF; no queryable zoning polygon service was found. The ArcGIS web map 'City of Ripley Zoning' points to an unrelated West Virginia layer (Ripley, WV). The county parcel layer (TippahService PARCEL_POLY) has no zoning field. Regrid zoning codes are a paid product.
